title: Jello project manifest
description: jello.json: what jelloc, jelloc run, jelloc test and deps.get read about a project.

name.description: The project's name. It names the module jelloc writes to build/, and deps.get needs it.

version.description: The project's version; a package's manifest needs it.

entry.description: The entry module, which jelloc and jelloc run compile when given no file. Relative to src.

src.description: The source directory, a root for imports.

dirs.description: The test directories jelloc test searches for *.test.jello files.

dependencies.description: Each package the project uses, by name.

oneOf.description: A released version: the archive of that tag of the package's repository.
A tag of a GitHub repository.
A commit of a GitHub repository.
A directory on disk, relative to the project; only in the project's own jello.json.

package_paths.description: Directories that also hold packages, as <dir>/<name>/.

jdll.description: The directory of the project's native libraries.
